name: HYDRA-UMC-VLA-ENGINE
build: Vision-Language-Action engine. Expect large model downloads on first installation for the real model integration (still future work).
notes: Real action-token encoding/decoding (OpenVLA/RT-2-style 256-bin discretization per action dimension) and trajectory generation (delta-pose integration, absolute gripper state) - the 'Action Tokens' and 'Trajectory Generator' steps of the VLA flow, exposed via 'tokens encode'/'tokens decode'/'trajectory integrate'. A real, versioned model manifest contract (model_manifest.py) plus shape/confidence validation for a future model's inference output, and an honest 'status' subcommand reporting real accelerator/model-weight availability (never a fake ready state). 46 tests. Real VLA model inference (OpenVLA/RT-2 on Hailo-10) remains future work.
